items.stem: A manager says 'we passed the NIST AI RMF audit, so we are compliant.' What is the misunderstanding?

options.text: The framework is a voluntary, outcome-oriented framework, not a pass/fail compliance certification
options.rationale: Correct: it is designed for voluntary adoption and continuous risk management, not certification.

options.text: The audit should have been annual
options.rationale: The deeper error is treating it as a certifiable compliance regime at all.

options.text: Only government agencies may use it
options.rationale: It is intended for broad voluntary use.

options.text: It replaces the firm's enterprise risk management
options.rationale: It is meant to integrate with existing risk management, not replace it.

items.explanation: Correct: it is designed for voluntary adoption and continuous risk management, not certification.

items.stem: Which TWO activities belong to the Map function (establishing context and identifying risks)? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Documenting the intended purpose, users and deployment setting of the AI system
options.rationale: Correct: establishing context is central to Map.

options.text: Identifying who could be harmed and the plausible failure modes
options.rationale: Correct: risk identification is a Map activity.

options.text: Defining the organisation's AI accountability roles and policies
Selecting and running test metrics on the model

items.explanation: Correct: establishing context is central to Map.

items.stem: Your team can measure latency and overall accuracy but cannot quantify a subtle dignity harm from automated rejections. What does the framework expect you to do?

options.text: Document the limitation and manage the residual risk through judgement and oversight rather than ignore it
options.rationale: Correct: the framework acknowledges not all risks are quantifiable and expects them to be documented and managed.

options.text: Drop the risk because it cannot be measured
options.rationale: Unmeasurable does not mean unmanaged under the framework.

options.text: Replace it with accuracy as a proxy
options.rationale: An unrelated proxy misrepresents the risk.

options.text: Wait until a metric exists before deploying
options.rationale: The framework expects documented management of residual risk, not indefinite delay by default.

items.explanation: Correct: the framework acknowledges not all risks are quantifiable and expects them to be documented and managed.
